name: blm-mcp-proxy
description: Proxies Claude tool calls to the BLM Analytics backend for NSE India market data, screener.in fundamentals, watchlists, and news.

remote_host.title: Backend Server Host
remote_host.description: Hostname or IP of the BLM backend server

remote_port.title: Backend Server Port
remote_port.description: Port the BLM backend MCP server is listening on

remote_path.title: Backend MCP Path
remote_path.description: URL path for the MCP endpoint on the backend server

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Return service health status.

tools.name: get_top_gainers
tools.description: Return today's top-gaining equities on NSE India.

tools.name: get_top_losers
tools.description: Return today's top-losing equities on NSE India.

tools.name: get_bulk_deals
tools.description: Return recent bulk deals for a specific stock symbol on NSE India.

tools.name: get_block_deals
tools.description: Return recent block deals for a specific stock symbol on NSE India.

tools.name: get_high_short_interest
tools.description: Return today's stocks with high short interest on NSE India.

tools.name: get_largedeal_snapshot
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of recent large deals (Insiders + bulk + block) across NSE.

tools.name: get_change_ranges
tools.description: Return percentage changes over multiple timeframes for a symbol from NSE.

tools.name: get_symbol_data
tools.description: Return live symbol data from NSE (LTP, dayHigh, dayLow, 52wk high/low, sector, industry).

tools.name: get_52week_low_stocks
tools.description: Return list of stocks which have crossed their previous NSE 52-week low.

tools.name: get_52week_high_stocks
tools.description: Return list of stocks which have crossed their previous NSE 52-week high.

tools.name: get_volume_gainers
tools.description: Returns list of stocks with highest volume gain compared to average weekly volume.

tools.name: screener_search
tools.description: Search screener.in for matching companies by name or symbol.

tools.name: screener_company
tools.description: Fetch parsed fundamentals for a company from screener.in (P/E, ROCE, ROE, quarters).

tools.name: screener_trades
tools.description: Fetch insider trades, bulk deals, and block deals for a company from screener.in.

tools.name: get_company_quarterly_results
tools.description: Return full quarterly results for a company from screener.in (consolidated).

tools.name: list_stock_universe
tools.description: Return all stock universe records from the database.

tools.name: get_stock_universe
tools.description: Return a single stock universe record by symbol from the database.

tools.name: search_stock_universe
tools.description: Return stock universe records that match the prefix in symbol or company name.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: Return all stocks the user is interested in, ordered by creation time.

tools.name: add_watchlist_item
tools.description: Add a symbol/exchange pair to the watchlist (idempotent).

tools.name: remove_watchlist_item
tools.description: Remove a watchlist item by its numeric id.

tools.name: get_global_news
tools.description: Return cached global news articles from MoneyControl.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Return news articles for a specific company symbol from MoneyControl.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Return all industries with their metadata from MoneyControl.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: Return all sectors with their metadata from MoneyControl.

tools.name: get_industry_stocks
tools.description: Return all stocks in a specific industry from MoneyControl.

tools.name: get_sector_stocks
tools.description: Return all stocks in a specific sector from MoneyControl.
